prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a static empty-state illustration for the Petani farming mobile app, square PNG, final export 1000 x 1000 pixels.
Reference image: the attached geometric farm scene is a reference for the isometric camera, miniature 3D diorama style, soil tile and charming tractor, not an image to reproduce exactly.
Create a polished isometric miniature pineapple farm on a thick square warm brown soil tile, with two visible soil sides and a neat diagonal diamond silhouette. Replace ALL paddy/wheat plants with clearly recognizable pineapple plants: low radial green spiky leaf rosettes with golden pineapple fruits and little green crowns growing at the center. Arrange the pineapple plants in perfectly straight, parallel, evenly spaced rows with consistent spacing, all rooted in the soil. Leave one clear dirt tractor lane, as in the reference, and place a single attractive tractor on that lane, viewed from above at three-quarter isometric angle facing lower right.
The tractor's hood and body must use Petani's primary rich forest green, exact base color #176B45 with natural lighting shades; ivory cab roof, dark glass, black rubber tires and green wheel hubs. No orange tractor body. No people.
Style: detailed but clean stylized 3D render, toy-like geometric agricultural diorama, soft ambient occlusion, warm daylight, crisp coherent shapes, friendly premium app illustration. Preserve the charming isometric scale and clear composition of the reference.
Composition: entire tile and tractor visible, center the complete scene horizontally and vertically, fill about 90% of canvas width with balanced modest clear margins. Do not place scene at the bottom under a large empty sky.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha outside the soil tile, with a subtle soft contact shadow only. No blue rectangle, no sky, no checkerboard graphic.
No text, no lettering, no labels, no watermark, no border. Exactly one tractor, orderly pineapple rows, no paddy, no wheat.
